mapper.select: SELECT ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL AS buttieLevel, ub.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP AS buttieTotalExp, (SELECT bl2.REQUIRED_EXP FROM BUTTIE_LEVEL bl2 WHERE bl2.LEVEL = ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL + 1) AS requiredExp, CASE COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') WHEN 'STABLE' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_STABLE WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_CAUTION WHEN 'DANGER' THEN bl.IMAGE_URL_DANGER END AS buttieImageUrl, COALESCE(s.RISK_LEVEL, 'STABLE') AS riskLevel, s.CURRENT_PREP_MONTHS AS currentPrepMonths, (SELECT sim.EXPECT_PREP_MONTHS FROM SIMULATION sim WHERE sim.USER_ID = ub.USER_ID AND sim.CONFIRMED_AT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sim.CONFIRMED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS expectPrepMonths, ep.TARGET_EMPLOYMENT_DATE AS targetEmploymentDate FROM USER_BUTTIE ub JOIN BUTTIE_LEVEL bl ON ub.BUTTIE_LEVEL = bl.LEVEL JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep ON ub.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SNAPSHOT s ON ub.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE ub.USER_ID = #{userId}
